title: You Feel Yourself Decide to Move, Yet Your Brain Starts 350 Milliseconds Earlier
description:
You feel in control when you flick your wrist, yet your brain fires first! Yet one clock test proved your cortex revs up before you decide! This is the true story of Benjamin Libet's Free Will Experiment. Here is what went wrong with common sense in nineteen eighty-three.
